intent: STORY-179 收口:备份/快照/核对机构重基完成。PG 备份路径(pg_dump 定制格式+摘要)、offsite verify 判据更新、engine-host:verify 的 DB 等价物,正腿(真备份+异地验证)+红腿(篡改一字节 verify 红)实证。

topology.configuredIn: deploy/aos-local-client/topology.mjs (VM half imported from deploy/aos-resident-cockpit/manifest.mjs); partition targets in deploy/aos-local-client/aos-partitions.mjs

argv: 【收口(2026-08-06)】备份/快照/核对机构重基完成。交付物(TCRN-AOS/deploy/aos-resident-cockpit/):①pg-backup-take.mjs——PG 取备份程序(只读 SELECT 取活链状态:events 数/head event_hash/全链 payload_hash 摘要/metadata+两店 marker sha256/连续性,pg_dump -F c 定制格式归档+sha256 sidecar,pg_restore --list 结构校验,产物带 partition/schema);②pg-backup-verify.mjs——异地 verify(摘要比对 dump 重算 sha256 vs sidecar+manifest+结构校验,不再逐文件树);③pg-chain-verify.mjs——engine-host:verify 的 DB 等价物(只读,事件行数+head+两店 marker digest 与预期比对,CHAIN_MATCHES_EXPECTED/DIFFERS);④pg-paired-backup.mjs——配套编排(复用 resident-lib stepper/state/transport+保留策略,PULL 方向不变,take→rsync PULL→异地 verify→红腿→轮换);⑤package.json 加 paired:backup-pg/paired:backup-pg-verify/pg:chain-verify。验收两侧(本机 Docker PG 实证,生产 VM PG 18 同机制留 STORY-188 窗前重跑):正腿=整条编排 ok=true(4 事件,PG_PAIR_TAKEN/PULLED/PG_BACKUP_VERIFIED),--verify-offsite 绿,dump sha256 三方一致;红腿=dump 第 100 字节翻转→verify DUMP_DIGEST_MISMATCH,注入漂移 knowledge_marker→pg-chain-verify CHAIN_DIFFERS_FROM_EXPECTED(两红均已复位)。文件备份路径 paired-backup.mjs/verify.mjs 零改动(git diff 空)。ADR §6 face 6 备份重定义达成。
